_style: Flat vector illustration, clean simple shapes, soft pastel colors, plain light background, no text, no letters, no watermark. Calm, respectful, instructional health-education poster style, clear hands, five fingers on each hand. Any visible hands, arms or skin belong to people with dark brown skin.
_aide: a friendly West African woman home health aide with dark brown skin, wearing teal scrubs and an orange head wrap
_client: an elderly Black woman client with short grey hair wearing a light blue gown
